protocol: A seeded sample of up to 10 loci where both sources assign different categories, 8 where they agree, 8 with exactly one assigning source, and 8 judged loci with no assignment was drawn at the published threshold, shuffled, and printed with --spot-check-sheet, which shows only the request states: the PCC 7942 product name and the GO terms, with no Jev answer, probability, or category. Each row was labelled per source against the frozen rubric before joining. Disclosure: the threshold was chosen from the cross-source calibration before this draw, and while reading that calibration the reviewer had printed 25 disagreeing loci with their answers; rows 8, 20, 23, 26, 28, and 33 (M744_RS02385, M744_RS01175, M744_RS05120, M744_RS04205, M744_RS04120, M744_RS06745) were in that list, and row 30 (M744_RS13955) is a known discrepancy from the GO IEA essentiality audit, so those seven rows were not blind to the model's answer.

Phage baseplate assembly.
Transcriptional regulator.

Histidine biosynthesis is amino acid biosynthesis.
GatB completes tRNA aminoacylation; the GO term is an enzyme class with no process.
Family name with no stated function; PLP binding only.
Thiamine biosynthesis.
NAD biosynthesis.
General chaperone.
Enzyme class without a named process.

ABC transporter.

Ribosome-binding factor by product; rRNA processing by GO term.

Amino-sugar metabolism.

Toxin-antitoxin system by product; the GO term names an RNA nuclease activity.
